questions.content:
(1) 克拉伯龙方程的导出

如图。构造 $T$ 和 $T + \Delta T$ 的等温线，相变潜热近似不变。

构造相变曲线之间的可逆卡诺循环，效率为
questions.analysis:
$$
\eta = \frac{\Delta T}{T}\tag{1}
$$

一个循环对外做功等于循环面积

$$
W = \Delta p \Delta V = \Delta p ( v _ { 2 } - v _ { 1 } )\tag{2}
$$

其中 $v _ { 1 }$、$v _ { 2 }$ 为工质的比摩尔体积。

一个循环的吸热为摩尔相变潜热

$$
Q = L\tag{3}
$$

则效率为

$$
\eta = \frac{W}{Q} = \frac{\Delta p(v_2 - v_1)}{L}\tag{4}
$$

联系卡诺循环效率，并取 $\Delta p \rightarrow 0$ 的极限，可得

$$
\frac{dp}{dT} = \frac{L}{T(v_2 - v_1)}\tag{5}
$$

此即克拉伯龙方程。它描述了相变发生的温度随压强、潜热、比体积的关系。

其中 $L , v _ { 1 } , v _ { 2 }$ 均非常数。相变潜热 $L$、比体积 $v _ { 1 }$、$v _ { 2 }$ 将随温度、压强变化而变化。

(2) 方程的粗糙解法

在考察气液相变时，我们认为液相比体积 $v _ { 1 }$ 远远小于气相比体积 $v _ { 2 }$，从而直接略去。（$\mu$ 是摩尔质量）

$$
\frac{dp}{dT} = \frac{p \mu L}{RT^2}\tag{6}
$$

上式已经利用

$$
v_{2} = \frac{1}{\rho_{2}} = \frac{RT}{p\mu}\tag{7}
$$

认为摩尔相变潜热近似为常数，分离变量积分

$$
\frac{dp}{p} = \frac{\mu LdT}{RT^{2}}\tag{8}
$$

$$
\Rightarrow \ln \frac{p}{p_{0}} = \frac{\mu L}{R} \left( \frac{1}{T_{0}} - \frac{1}{T} \right)\tag{9.1}
$$

或表述为

$$
T = \left( \frac{1}{T_0} + \frac{R}{\mu L} \ln \frac{p_0}{p} \right)^{-1}\tag{9.2}
$$

(3) 考虑了摩尔相变潜热不为常数的近似解

略去 $v _ { 1 }$，方程写作

$$
\frac{dp}{dT} = \frac{L}{Tv_{2}}\tag{10}
$$

摩尔相变潜热等于摩尔焓之差

$$
L = H_{m}^{2} - H_{m}^{1}\tag{11}
$$

相变潜热应当为相变温度的函数，摩尔焓应当是两个特征参量确定的态函数，这里作展开。计算其变化率为

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{d L}{d T} = & \left( \left( \frac{\partial H_{m}^{2}}{\partial T} \right)_{p} + \left( \frac{\partial H_{m}^{2}}{\partial p} \right)_{T} \frac{d p}{d T} \right) - \left( \left( \frac{\partial H_{m}^{1}}{\partial T} \right)_{p} + \left( \frac{\partial H_{m}^{1}}{\partial p} \right)_{T} \frac{d p}{d T} \right) \\= & \left[ \left( \frac{\partial H_{m}^{2}}{\partial T} \right)_{p} - \left( \frac{\partial H_{m}^{1}}{\partial T} \right)_{p} \right] + \left[ \left( \frac{\partial H_{m}^{2}}{\partial p} \right)_{T} - \left( \frac{\partial H_{m}^{1}}{\partial p} \right)_{T} \right] \frac{d p}{d T}\end{aligned}\tag{12}
$$

利用克拉伯龙方程及热力学关系

$$
\begin{aligned}\left(\frac{\partial H_{m}}{\partial T}\right)_{p} &= c_{p,m} \\\left(\frac{\partial H_{m}}{\partial p}\right)_{T} &= V - T\left(\frac{\partial H_{m}}{\partial T}\right)_{p} \\\frac{d L}{d T} = c_{p,m}^{2} - c_{p,m}^{1} + \frac{L}{T} &+ \frac{L}{v_{2} - v_{1}}\left(\left(\frac{\partial v_{1}}{\partial T}\right)_{p} - \left(\frac{\partial v_{2}}{\partial T}\right)_{p}\right)\end{aligned}\tag{13}
$$

对于气液相变有近似 $v _ { 2 } \gg v _ { 1 }$

再利用

$$
v _ { 2 } = \frac { R T } { p \mu }\tag{15}
$$

化简可知（13）式第三项和第四项抵消。于是

$$
\frac { d L } { d T } = c _ { p , m } ^ { 2 } - c _ { p , m } ^ { 1 }\tag{16}
$$

认为定压摩尔热容为常数，积分得

$$
L = L _ { 0 } + ( c _ { p , m } ^ { 2 } - c _ { p , m } ^ { 1 } ) T\tag{17}
$$

代入克拉伯龙方程，得到

$$
\frac { d p } { d T } = \frac { p \mu } { R T ^ { 2 } } ( L _ { 0 } + ( c _ { p , m } ^ { 2 } - c _ { p , m } ^ { 1 } ) T )\tag{18}
$$

$$
\Rightarrow \ln \frac { p } { p _ { 0 } } = \frac { \mu L } { R } \left( \frac { 1 } { T _ { 0 } } - \frac { 1 } { T } \right) + \frac { \mu \left( c _ { p , m } ^ { 2 } - c _ { p , m } ^ { 1 } \right) } { R } \ln \frac { T } { T _ { 0 } }\tag{19}
$$

这就得到了考量相变潜热随温度变化的克拉伯龙方程解。

对比考虑这一项变化前后的解，多了一项 $A\ln T$，正是来源于相变潜热的线性变化。

score.note: 关键在识别康托尔地毯的自相似结构并建立迭代递推关系，属非常规建模；后续涉及复杂的复数级数求和与三角函数积化和差，计算量极大且易错。

questions.content:
> ⚠️ 本题题干未收录：原卷为答案卷，库中没有对应的题目版。以下为原卷解答。

(1.1)矩孔衍射，从次波源相干叠加的观点写出菲涅尔衍射积分式，忽略倾斜因子。注意运算式不要落下 $\frac{-i}{\lambda}$ 因子，记得 $\frac{1}{r}\to\frac{1}{f}$ 变换。

$$u(P) = -\frac{i}{\lambda}\int_{-\frac{a}{2}}^{\frac{a}{2}}\int_{-\frac{a}{2}}^{\frac{a}{2}}u_{0}\frac{e^{ik\cdot r}}{f}dxdy$$

$$U_{0}=\frac{-ia^{2}u_{0}}{\lambda f}\frac{\sin\alpha_{0}}{\alpha_{0}}\frac{\sin\beta_{0}}{\beta_{0}}\tag{1}$$

$$\frac{a^{4}u_{0}^{2}}{\lambda^{2}f^{2}}\left(\frac{\sin\alpha_{0}}{\alpha_{0}}\right)^{2}\left(\frac{\sin\beta_{0}}{\beta_{0}}\right)^{2}\tag{2}$$

其中 $\alpha_{0}=\frac{\pi a\sin\theta_{1}}{\lambda},\beta_{0}=\frac{\pi a\sin\theta_{2}}{\lambda}$

(1.2)衍射孔位移相当于附加相位差。在复振幅表述下相当于乘了一个复的相位因子。

$$e^{i\delta}=e^{-ik(x\sin\theta_{1}+y\sin\theta_{2})}\tag{3}$$

(2)

(2.1)我们将八个小孔分别编号为1~8，写出他们的复振幅分别如下

$$u_{i}=c_{i}\frac{\sin\alpha_{1}}{\alpha_{1}}\frac{\sin\beta_{1}}{\beta_{1}}\tag{4}$$

$$\begin{aligned}c_{1} &= \frac{1}{9}c_{0}e^{-i(ka\sin\theta_{1}+ka\sin\theta_{2})} \\c_{2} &= \frac{1}{9}c_{0}e^{-i(ka\sin\theta_{1}-ka\sin\theta_{2})} \\c_{3} &= \frac{1}{9}c_{0}e^{-i(-ka\sin\theta_{1}+ka\sin\theta_{2})} \\c_{4} &= \frac{1}{9}c_{0}e^{-i(-ka\sin\theta_{1}-ka\sin\theta_{2})} \\c_{5} &= \frac{1}{9}c_{0}e^{-i(ka\sin\theta_{1})} \\c_{6} &= \frac{1}{9}c_{0}e^{-i(ka\sin\theta_{2})} \\c_{7} &= \frac{1}{9}c_{0}e^{-i(-ka\sin\theta_{1})} \\c_{8} &= \frac{1}{9}c_{0}e^{-i(-ka\sin\theta_{2})}\end{aligned}\tag{5-12}$$

求和得

$$U_{1}=\sum_{i=1}^{8}u_{i}\tag{13}$$

其中有 $\alpha_{0}=3\alpha_{1},\beta_{0}=3\beta_{1}$

(2.2)将 $C_{1}$ 作为新一代的 $c_{0}$，直接带入变换式，注意作变换 $a\to\frac{a}{3}$
questions.analysis:
(1)

可得

$$\begin{aligned}U_{2} &= \frac{2}{9}C_{1}\frac{\sin\alpha_{2}}{\alpha_{2}}\frac{\sin\beta_{2}}{\beta_{2}}\left[\cos\left(\frac{ka\sin\theta_{1}+ka\sin\theta_{2}}{3}\right)+\cos\left(\frac{ka\sin\theta_{1}-ka\sin\theta_{2}}{3}\right)\right] \\&= \frac{2}{9}\left(\frac{2}{9}c_{0}\left[\cos(ka\sin\theta_{1}+ka\sin\theta_{2})+\cos(ka\sin\theta_{1}-ka\sin\theta_{2})\right.\right. \\&\quad \left.+\cos(ka\sin\theta_{1})+\cos(ka\sin\theta_{2})\right]\frac{\sin\alpha_{2}}{\alpha_{2}}\frac{\sin\beta_{2}}{\beta_{2}}\left[\cos\left(\frac{ka\sin\theta_{1}+ka\sin\theta_{2}}{3}\right)\right. \\&\quad \left.\left.+\cos\left(\frac{ka\sin\theta_{1}-ka\sin\theta_{2}}{3}\right)+\cos\frac{ka\sin\theta_{1}}{3}+\cos\frac{ka\sin\theta_{2}}{3}\right]\right) \\&= \left(\frac{2}{9}\right)^{2}c_{0}\frac{\sin\alpha_{2}}{\alpha_{2}}\frac{\sin\beta_{2}}{\beta_{2}}\left[\cos(ka\sin\theta_{1}+ka\sin\theta_{2})+\cos(ka\sin\theta_{1}-ka\sin\theta_{2})\right. \\&\quad \left.+\cos(ka\sin\theta_{1})+\cos(ka\sin\theta_{2})\right]\left[\cos\left(\frac{ka\sin\theta_{1}+ka\sin\theta_{2}}{3}\right)\right. \\&\quad \left.+\cos\left(\frac{ka\sin\theta_{1}-ka\sin\theta_{2}}{3}\right)+\cos\frac{ka\sin\theta_{1}}{3}+\cos\frac{ka\sin\theta_{2}}{3}\right]\end{aligned}\tag{14}$$

其中有 $\alpha_{1}=3\alpha_{2},\beta_{1}=3\beta_{2}$

如此迭代N代再求和，即得最终康托尔地毯的衍射复振幅分布。

$$\begin{aligned}u_{N} &= \sum U_{N} \\&= c_{0}\sum_{n=0}^{N-1}\left\{\left(\frac{2}{9}\right)^{n}c_{0}\frac{\sin\alpha_{n}}{\alpha_{n}}\frac{\sin\beta_{n}}{\beta_{n}}\prod_{i=0}^{n-1}\left[\cos\frac{(ka\sin\theta_{1}+ka\sin\theta_{2})}{3^{i}}\right.\right. \\&\quad \left.\left.+\cos\frac{(ka\sin\theta_{1}-ka\sin\theta_{2})}{3^{i}}+\cos\frac{ka\sin\theta_{1}}{3^{i}}+\cos\frac{ka\sin\theta_{2}}{3^{i}}\right]\right\}\end{aligned}\tag{15}$$

需要注意的是，当 $n=0$，我们应当默认连乘项为常数1。
questions.answer:
> 康托尔地毯的衍射复振幅分布为
>
> $$u_{N}=c_{0}\sum_{n=0}^{N-1}\left\{\left(\frac{2}{9}\right)^{n}c_{0}\frac{\sin\alpha_{n}}{\alpha_{n}}\frac{\sin\beta_{n}}{\beta_{n}}\prod_{i=0}^{n-1}\left[\cos\frac{(ka\sin\theta_{1}+ka\sin\theta_{2})}{3^{i}}+\cos\frac{(ka\sin\theta_{1}-ka\sin\theta_{2})}{3^{i}}+\cos\frac{ka\sin\theta_{1}}{3^{i}}+\cos\frac{ka\sin\theta_{2}}{3^{i}}\right]\right\}$$
>
> 其中 $n=0$ 时默认连乘项为常数 1。
